```{r}
#| label: cvevents
cvevents <- function(tbl, when, what, where, descr) {
  command_start <- "\\cvevent"
  tbl[[where]] <- gsub("\n", " \\\\newline ", tbl[[where]])
  res <- paste0(
    command_start, "{", tbl[[when]], "}", 
    "{", tbl[[what]], "}",
    "{", tbl[[where]], "}"
  )
  cat(res, sep = "\n\n\n")
}
```

# Profile

Senior R Developer with expertise in clinical trial, 
software architecture, and production deployment. Specialist in 
R package development, and CI/CD. Track record
 of generating CDISC-compliant TFLs and automating regulatory workflows. 
 Strongly involved in open source and technical mentoring.

# Experience

\cvevent{02/2025 - Present}{Senior R Developer}{Cytel for Johnson \& Johnson}

-   -- Leading the R Team at Johnson \& Johnson managing the strategic transition from SAS: steering, evangelization, and continuous training of clinical teams

-   -- Intensive development of validated R packages for clinical trial programming, specifically aligned with CDISC standards

-   -- Implementation of automated reporting systems to efficiently generate TFLs (Tables, Figures, Listings) for regulatory submissions

-   -- Design, performance testing, and maintenance of analytical infrastructures (Posit Server) hosting Shiny applications in a strictly regulated environment

<br>

\cvevent{01/2024 - 02/2025}{Data Science Consultant}{Freelance - Pharmaceutical \& Tech}

-   -- Led end-to-end data projects with full autonomy, mapping user requirements to scalable architecture and final deployment

-   -- Developed high-performance custom R Shiny containerized apps, integrating REST APIs and implementing rigorous unit testing: See \href{https://ecocalc.eu/}{\underline{here}} for the Chemical Intelligence Platform for Sustainable Design

-   -- Predictive modeling and automation of data pipelines utilizing tidyverse and advanced data visualization libraries (ggplot2, echarts4r, plotly)

<br>

\cvevent{2023 - Present}{Key Contributor \& Developer}{Opifex}

-   -- **echarts4r:** Lead maintainer, high-impact visualization package. Widely adopted across the R community for generating complex, interactive charts (used in production by numerous enterprises and research groups), bridging R data workflows with Apache ECharts.

-   -- **fiRebase:** Lead maintainer, enable secure, scalable backend integrations (authentication, real-time databases) for R Shiny applications, ensuring robust infrastructure for data-driven web apps.

<br>

\cvevent{03/2023 - 01/2024}{Data Scientist}{FlowBank}

-   -- Led the data team in evolving the architecture and creating the bank's analytical platforms (Data Science, Data Engineering, DevOps)

-   -- Custom Dashboards: Developed containerized R Shiny applications for interactive data exploration, featuring advanced visualizations (plotly, echarts4r) that support rapid decision-making.

-   -- Maintained machine learning pipelines and provided daily technical mentoring to internal cross-functional teams

-   -- Developed internal analytical tools and automated reporting processes for business teams

-   -- Created secure, documented, and tested internal R packages to meet banking sector constraints

-   -- Conducted exploratory analysis of financial data and laid the groundwork for the internal R infrastructure

<br>

\cvevent{09/2020 - 01/2022}{Lecturer in Biostatistics}{University of Geneva}

-   -- Taught statistics and led practical workshops in R and Python

-   -- Created and maintained course materials and technical documentation for graduate students

<br>

\cvevent{03/2020 - 01/2022}{Research Scientist}{Novo Nordisk}

-   -- Clinical Pipelines: Developed large-scale R pipelines for processing and visualizing clinical trial datasets and sensory alteration data.

-   -- Advanced Modeling: Applied Bayesian statistics and machine learning to extract insights from complex biological data.

-   -- Collaboration: Partnered with international teams to define data requirements and deliver analytical outputs.

<br>
